notes: Found with WebSearch, then read with WebFetch (page text summarised by a small model, so figures are as that summary reported them). Every entry's source_url is a page that was fetched and that itself names the investor; facts seen only in search snippets are in gaps. Investor names are as each source gives them (Bynd Venture Capital was formerly Busy Angels; Bright Pixel was formerly Sonae IM). No websummit.com, lu.ma, luma.com, meetup.com or eventbrite pages were fetched. Reviewed by startups.b@PrompTugal.dinis on 19 November 2026: each source page re-read in its raw HTML; every amount and every investor name matched.

entries.name: Meight seed round
investors: European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT)
entries.what: Portuguese freight-transport software startup Meight closed a seed round led by Faber to expand its AI platform for road freight operations and to recruit.
entries.how_read: WebFetch summary of the ECO article; the date is the article's publication date and the article does not state the company's base city

entries.name: Meight seed round (second)
entries.what: Meight raised a seed round led by Cusp Capital with Faber among the other investors, to automate freight planning and monitoring for carriers.
entries.how_read: WebFetch summary of the Executive Digest article; the date is the article's publication date and the article does not state the company's base city

entries.name: Chic by Choice financing round
entries.what: Portuguese designer-dress rental startup Chic by Choice closed a financing round led by its existing shareholders, including Faber Ventures. This is older than 2022 and is kept only because it names Faber Ventures.
entries.how_read: WebFetch summary of the Dinheiro Vivo article; the date is the article's publication date, the round type is not stated, and the company's base city is not stated

entries.name: Delox Series A
entries.what: Delox, a University of Lisbon spin-off that makes a bio-decontamination device for laboratory equipment, closed a Series A led by Beta Capital for certification, production and entry to European and North American markets.
entries.how_read: WebFetch summary of the Business-IT article; the date is the article's publication date; Lisbon is inferred from the team working at Tec Labs of the Faculty of Sciences of the University of Lisbon, the article does not name the city Place set to national by startups.b@ on review: the source does not name the company's city (it was inferred as lisboa).

entries.name: Azitek investment round
entries.what: Azitek, which develops IoT asset-tracking technology for industry, raised a round led by Beta Capital to enter other European markets.
entries.how_read: WebFetch summary of the Business-IT article; the date is the article's publication date and the round type is not stated; Porto is inferred from the company being incubated at UPTEC, the article does not name its base city Place set to national by startups.b@ on review: the source does not name the company's city (it was inferred as porto).

entries.name: Vawlt seed round
entries.what: Vawlt, which builds a long-term data storage product on a cloud-of-clouds design, closed a seed round led by Lince Capital with Beta Capital taking part.
entries.how_read: WebFetch summary of the Business-IT article; the date is the article's publication date and the article does not state the company's base city

entries.name: Beta Capital
entries.what: Investor that led Azitek's 750,000-euro round in June 2024, with Portugal Ventures and Cedrus Capital, as the source reports it.
entries.how_read: Raw HTML of the article re-read by startups.b@PrompTugal.dinis on 19 November 2026 ("O financiamento foi liderado pela Beta Capital").

entries.name: Bynd into Relive
entries.what: Relive, a proptech platform with tools for estate agents to rent, buy and sell homes, closed a Series A led by Indico Capital Partners with Shilling and Bynd taking part. The money is for hiring, the platform and expansion from Texas into more US states.
entries.how_read: WebFetch summary of the Portugal Global article (date as listed on the page); the page names the Lisbon-based team; Bynd was formerly Busy Angels; Relive's money is mainly for the US business.

entries.name: Beta Capital into LoopOS
entries.what: LoopOS, which offers a no-code platform for companies to run circular-economy channels such as returns, repairs, trade-ins and resale, closed a round led by the Impact Innovation Fund of 3XP Global, with Beta Capital and FundBox taking part. The money is for the technology tools and for the Portuguese, Spanish and French markets. The EIB page https://www.eib.org/en/stories/portugal-circular-economy, read on 2026-11-21, says The Loop offers LoopOS and is in a building in central Coimbra, so the city is taken from that page (the Jornal Economico source gave none).
entries.how_read: WebFetch summary of the Jornal Economico article; the page does not name the company's city; the round type is not stated there (a Nordic9 page tags it seed).

entries.name: Beta Capital into PFx Biotech
entries.what: PFx Biotech, which uses precision fermentation to make bioidentical human milk proteins such as lactoferrin, closed a seed round led by Buenavista Equity Partners with EIT Food and Beta Capital. A separate EUR 2.5 million EIC Accelerator grant came with it; the money is for scaling production, labs and the team.
entries.how_read: WebFetch summary of the Startup Rise article, which gives Porto as the base; the date is the page's announcement date; a Vegconomist page dates it 9 June 2025 and does not name a city.
